text:
hana: kicking off a config-only rollout in the 01:00-01:45 PT change window. scope: tighten per-tenant ceilings, shorten timeouts, and shrink batch window to reduce tail cost. plan: max_concurrency 56 -> 36, timeout 65s -> 48s, batch_window 14ms -> 6ms. canary: 1% -> 12% -> 100%. release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-surge-hook
release-manager: noted. please attach preflight and add abort thresholds: p95 +20% OR 5xx_rate >0.5% sustained 2m. pin fallback policy route:stable-legacy before canary.
vik: will run preflight and KV warmup. recommend splitting canary across 3 AZs and two instance pools to avoid single-type bias. also prepare quick rollback commands.
sre-lead: monitoring set: p95_latency, overall 5xx_rate, tenant_5xx, kv_cache_miss_rate, gpu_mem. alert triggers: 5xx >0.5% for 2m OR p95 > baseline*1.2. Pager if tenant_5xx >1% for any tenant.
hana: config snippet to apply:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 36,
  "timeout_s": 48,
  "batch_window_ms": 6,
  "routing_weights": {"canary-hook": 1, "default": 99}
}
```
vik: lgtm. I'll prewarm top tenants with /ops/warm_kv.sh and stage a soft-throttle command: `rb config set --batch_window_ms 4 --max_concurrency 30` ready.
deploybot: deploybot: release "surge-hook-config-2026-03" queued by hana. pipeline: validate -> canary(1%) -> wait(10m) -> canary(12%) -> wait(15m) -> ramp(100%). running preflight smoke.
deploybot: preflight smoke: OK (auth, quick-gen, embed lookup)
ops-bot: preflight checklist posted: warm_kv, pin-fallback, soft-throttle cmd ready, alert channels configured (#incidents, #eng-oncall).
vik: starting warm_kv for tenants P,Q,R now.
deploybot: canary(1%) started at 01:05:12 PT distributed across 3 AZs and instance pools. monitoring.
sre-lead: initial readouts: p50 down, p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +11% for P (expected). no 5xx.
hana: holding 1% for 10m. will observe then bump to 12% if green.
deploybot: canary(1%) passed 10m gate at 01:15:14 PT. proceeding to 12% at 01:18:00 PT.
vik: re-running warm_kv and revalidating shard mapping before 12%.
sre-lead: at 12% we see a small 5xx spike concentrated on tenant S (tenant_5xx = 2.6%). isolating S from canary with `tenant-exclude S` and routing S to fallback.
hana: applying `tenant-exclude S` now. also enabling route flip for S -> route:stable-legacy.
deploybot: tenant-exclude S applied; fallback route for S enabled.
vik: ops note: rather than full rollback, try soft-throttle for nodes handling S: set batch_window_ms 5 -> 4 and max_concurrency 36 -> 30 for that tenant's shard. prepared command executed.
sre-lead: after soft-throttle, tenant S 5xx drops to 0.5% then to 0.2%. system 5xx back below threshold. good mitigation.
release-manager: decision: continue to ramp to 100% after 15m observe if no new alerts. rollback cutoff remains 01:40.
hana: setting rollback timer and keeping the quick flip cmd `rb traffic set --policy route:stable-legacy --all` handy.
deploybot: canary(12%) held for 15m and passed gates. ramp to 100% started at 01:33:50 PT. final checks running.
vik: post-ramp quick checks: p95 improved ~9% vs baseline, cost-per-token down modestly. no sustained 5xx spikes.
sre-lead: capturing perf snapshot and saving to perf-archive/surge-hook/2026-03. archiving logs for tenant S for follow-up.
hana: closing change window early at 01:38 PT. tagging config commit cfg@b7c6d5 and pushing final release note update.
release-manager: thanks team. will publish post-deploy summary AM and mark release: success. :tada: 
vik: updating runbook with tenant-exclude flow and soft-throttle steps. adding notes to customer ops ticket for tenant S.
ops-bot: perf snapshot saved. thread closed.
